events.title: 11th Annual Winter Fat Bike Race & Gingerbread Man Foot Race
events.description: Be BOLD, brave the COLD at the 11th Annual Winter Fat Bike Race & Gingerbread Man Foot Race in the North Dakota Badlands! Whether you’re on Bold St. Nick’s naughty list or nice list, you will experience the world-famous Maah Daah Hey like few racers ever have—frozen! 🥶 Registration for the 2026 Bold St. Nick’s Winter Race will include multiple race options: 🎄 Gingerbread Man Foot Race🚴 2 Hour “Nice List” Fat Bike Race🚴 4 Hour “Naughty List” Fat Bike Race🦌 Reindeer Team Option — Teams of 2– 6 fat bike racers FAT BIKES ONLY! FATBIKE participants must compete on a FAT TIRE BIKE. (minimum 3.8” tires) No other bicycle types will be permitted. No e-bikes.

events.title: Midwinter Table at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library
events.description: A seated, three-course dinner on the opening night of Cowboy Christmas. Every course highlights a local ingredient or producer, and the producers attend to talk about their work. The menu, prepared by Salt + Scoria, celebrates the hardiness of the people of the Badlands: preserved and smoked foods, winter-foraged ingredients, and a through-line from Indigenous foodways to homesteading, ranching, and today’s growers. Reception at 6:00 PM, dinner at 7:00 PM. $150 per person, 75 seats, with optional beer and wine pairings. Paired with Cowboy Christmas, Midwinter Table makes for a perfect weekend getaway in Medora.

Countdown to the New Year before settling in for a stay at the all-new Hotel 1883. Gather friends and loved ones for a special celebration that pairs a touch of luxury with the warmth and charm of Medora.

events.title: Teddy Roosevelt at the Menger Hotel, San Antonio, Texas
events.description:
Join us at the historic Menger Hotel in San Antonio, Texas, and experience the legendary Theodore Roosevelt come to life in an unforgettable show!

Joe Wiegand, the world’s premiere Theodore Roosevelt reprisor, will share stories of his time in San Antonio recruiting Rough Riders, his path to the White House, and how the West shaped his conservation legacy. Before the main show, get into the Americana mood with music by folk artist Tom Brosseau and Queen of the West, Emily Walter. Enjoy a delicious meal by the Menger Hotel’s chefs and take in the rich history of the hotel – a place that has hosted countless influential figures throughout the years, including Teddy himself! Whether you’re a history enthusiast or a lover of live music, join us in celebrating the legacy of one of America’s most beloved presidents through entertainment and delicious eats.

Tickets do not include a stay at the Menger Hotel.

events.title: Medora’s Cowboy Christmas
events.description:
Join us in Medora for Winter hospitality at its finest! Eats on the streets, shopping, dancing, and entertainment for the whole family to enjoy — all amidst western Christmas decor and snow-capped buttes. Hosted by the Medora Chamber Of Commerce.  Join us at the Old Town Hall Theater from 10am-1pm for a free photo with Santa and a commemorative frame! Eats on the Streets:

Old Town Hall–Fresh Cotton Candy Buffalo Gap Gifts–Meatball Sliders Rough Riders Gits–Charecuterie Cups
